name: Slaughterhouse Why
source:
Porkhos, Tauros and Chickamis are on their way to a rave in an abandoned farm in the outskirts of their town.

Suddenly a dark figure appears out of nowhere, forcing them off the road. All goes black. You and your friends wake up inside a meat locker.

Can you find your way out... intact?

[From [url=https://jani-peippo.itch.io/slaughterhouse-why]Itch.io[/url]]
